title: Seam-Release Step in the Original-State Summand
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with state set $S$, let $a$ be a state of $M$, and let $c$ be any configuration for $M$. One step of the seam-release machine from the configuration obtained by renaming $c$'s state into the right summand equals the configuration obtained by taking one step of $M$ from $c$ and renaming its state into the right summand.
